texts.facts: In this case, a Detailed Accident Report (hereinafter referred as DAR) was filed by IO Padam Singh in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act, which is treated as Claim Petition under Section 166 (1) read with Section 166 (4) MV Act. It pertains to alleged accident of injured Pawan Kumar Gupta (hereinafter referred as claimant), by vehicle bearing Reg. No. DL 1PC 7602 (hereinafter referred as offending vehicle), which was driven by Parveen (hereinafter referred as R-1), owned by DTC, Tehkhand Depot (hereinafter referred as R-2), and insured with United India Insurance Company Limited (hereinafter referred as R-3). 2. Preliminary information about the accident was received on 13.06.2018 recorded vide DD no.24A at PS Okhla Industrial Area. In response to which, HC Padam Singh proceeded to ESI Hospital, Okhla and procured the MLC of injured Pawan Kumar Gupta which mentioned the alleged history of Road Traffic Accident in front of Teh Khand Bus Depot who was already referred to another hospital, by the time HC Padam Singh reached there. On 14.06.2018, statement of injured was recorded MACT No.:56/2019 at his own residence wherein, he explained that while he was waiting at Tehkhand Depot, Okhla Phase-1, on 13.06.2018 at about 10.00 am, to catch a bus for Faridabad, a red colour bus bearing Reg. No. DL 1PC 7602 which came out of depot on the main road halted and started taking passengers from the front door and when claimant was in a process to alight, the said door was shut and his right lower limb came under the wheel of the bus which is how he got seriously injured . He also pointed that the bus driver, despite realising what he had done, fled away with the bus. He underlined that he sustained injuries due to rash and negligent driving of offending bus. FIR was registered on the basis of MLC and statement of injured. Site plan was prepared. Investigation was undertaken. Notice u/s 133 MV Act was served upon Depot Manager who produced the bus as well as driver of the said bus informing that Praveen was driving the bus at the time of accident. Duty Memo was also handed over to Investigating Officer by Depot Manager. The offending vehicle was taken into police possession. Mechanical Inspection was got conducted. Documents pertaining to offending vehicle as well as DL of driver were verified and found to be genuine. R-1 refused to participate in the TIP. Upon conclusion of investigation, Charge-sheet u/s 279/338 IPC was filed before Ld. Ilaka MM while DAR was filed in the Tribunal for adjudicating the compensation under Motor Vehicles Act. however, no reply was filed by R-1 & R-2.
